title: Configuração Completa de uma Stack de Monitoramento
description: Implante e configure o Prometheus e o Grafana para um monitoramento abrangente de aplicações e infraestrutura.

steps.title: Implante o Servidor Prometheus
steps.description: Configure o servidor Prometheus para coletar (scrape) métricas de múltiplos alvos.
steps.codeExample:
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'
services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - ./alert_rules.yml:/etc/prometheus/alert_rules.yml
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-admin-api'

# prometheus.yml
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

rule_files:
  - "alert_rules.yml"

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']
  
  - job_name: 'node-exporter'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['node-exporter:9100']
  
  - job_name: 'sample-app'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['sample-app:8080']

alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
          - alertmanager:9093

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
validationCriteria: O Prometheus está acessível na porta 9090
A página de targets do Prometheus mostra os jobs configurados
steps.expectedOutput: Prometheus server running and ready to scrape metrics

steps.title: Implante o Node Exporter para Métricas de Sistema
steps.description: Adicione o Node Exporter para coletar métricas em nível de sistema da máquina host.
steps.codeExample:
# Add to docker-compose.yml services section:
  node-exporter:
    image: prom/node-exporter:latest
    container_name: node-exporter
    ports:
      - "9100:9100"
    volumes:
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
      - /:/rootfs:ro
    command:
      - '--path.procfs=/host/proc'
      - '--path.rootfs=/rootfs'
      - '--path.sysfs=/host/sys'
      - '--collector.filesystem.mount-points-exclude=^/(sys|proc|dev|host|etc)($$|/)'
    restart: unless-stopped

  sample-app:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: sample-app
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
      - ./nginx_status.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/status.conf
validationCriteria: O Node Exporter expõe métricas na porta 9100
O Prometheus descobre o target node-exporter
A aplicação de exemplo está em execução
hints: Verifique a página de targets do Prometheus para confirmar o scraping
O Node Exporter fornece métricas de sistema como CPU, memória e disco

steps.title: Implante e Configure o Grafana
steps.description: Configure o Grafana com o Prometheus como fonte de dados e importe dashboards.
steps.codeExample:
# Add to docker-compose.yml services section:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: grafana
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards
    depends_on:
      - prometheus

# grafana/provisioning/datasources/prometheus.yml
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: http://prometheus:9090
    isDefault: true
    editable: true

# grafana/provisioning/dashboards/dashboard.yml
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: 'default'
    orgId: 1
    folder: ''
    type: file
    disableDeletion: false
    updateIntervalSeconds: 10
    options:
      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
validationCriteria: O Grafana está acessível na porta 3000
A fonte de dados do Prometheus está configurada
O login de admin funciona com admin123
steps.expectedOutput: Grafana dashboard ready with Prometheus data source

steps.title: Crie Dashboards de Monitoramento Personalizados
steps.description: Construa dashboards abrangentes para métricas de sistema, desempenho de aplicações e monitoramento de infraestrutura.
validationCriteria: O dashboard personalizado carrega no Grafana
As métricas de CPU e memória são exibidas corretamente

steps.title: Configure o AlertManager para Notificações
steps.description: Implante o AlertManager e configure regras de alerta para condições críticas do sistema.
steps.codeExample:
# Add to docker-compose.yml services section:
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:latest
    container_name: alertmanager
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'

# alertmanager.yml
global:
  smtp_smarthost: 'localhost:587'
  smtp_from: 'alerts@example.com'

route:
  group_by: ['alertname']
  group_wait: 10s
  group_interval: 10s
  repeat_interval: 1h
  receiver: 'web.hook'

receivers:
- name: 'web.hook'
  webhook_configs:
  - url: 'http://localhost:5001/'
    send_resolved: true

# alert_rules.yml
groups:
- name: system.rules
  rules:
  - alert: HighCPUUsage
    expr: 100 - (avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100) > 80
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: "High CPU usage detected"
      description: "CPU usage is above 80% for more than 2 minutes"

  - alert: HighMemoryUsage
    expr: (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * 100 > 85
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "High memory usage detected"
      description: "Memory usage is above 85% for more than 5 minutes"

  - alert: DiskSpaceLow
    expr: (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"}) * 100 < 10
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "Disk space is low"
      description: "Less than 10% disk space remaining"
validationCriteria: O AlertManager está acessível na porta 9093
As regras de alerta estão carregadas no Prometheus
O Prometheus se conecta ao AlertManager
steps.expectedOutput: AlertManager ready to receive and process alerts from Prometheus

steps.title: Teste de Carga e Validação de Alertas
steps.description: Gere carga no sistema para testar a configuração de monitoramento e validar se os alertas disparam corretamente.
steps.codeExample:
# stress-test.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo "Starting system stress test..."

# CPU stress test
echo "Generating CPU load..."
for i in $(seq $(nproc)); do
  yes > /dev/null &
done

# Memory stress test  
echo "Generating memory pressure..."
stress-ng --vm 2 --vm-bytes 75% --timeout 300s &

# Monitor alerts
echo "Monitoring for alerts..."
for i in {1..20}; do
  echo "Checking alerts (attempt $i)..."
  curl -s http://localhost:9090/api/v1/alerts | jq '.data.alerts[] | select(.state=="firing") | {alertname: .labels.alertname, state: .state}'
  sleep 30
done

# Cleanup
echo "Cleaning up stress test..."
killall yes 2>/dev/null
killall stress-ng 2>/dev/null
echo "Stress test complete!"
commands: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y stress-ng jq
validationCriteria: O teste de estresse dispara alto uso de CPU/memória
O Prometheus detecta as violações de limite
O AlertManager recebe e processa os alertas
Os dashboards do Grafana mostram métricas elevadas
hints: Instale o stress-ng e o jq para o teste de carga
Monitore tanto os alertas do Prometheus quanto os dashboards do Grafana
Limpe os processos de estresse após o teste
steps.expectedOutput: Alerts fire during load test and resolve after cleanup

completionCriteria: Os dashboards do Grafana exibem dados
Os alertas estão configurados e disparando
O monitoramento cobre tanto a infraestrutura quanto as aplicações
